verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents a built-in rate limiter with customizable rules, including strict per-path limits like 3 requests/10s on /sign-in/email, which directly mitigates brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks, plus secure password hashing (scrypt) and 2FA/backup codes as additional layers. However, there is no evidence of dedicated bot/CAPTCHA detection, IP reputation, breached-password checks, or anomaly-based bot mitigation beyond simple rate limiting. missing for 10: explicit bot detection/CAPTCHA integration, credential-stuffing-specific defenses (e.g., breached password screening), independent security audit or hands-on validation of these protections.
